input: One checked typed Rule v1 or v2 closure and the current exact field model used by its named paths.
output: One public pure Rust function item in src/domain/rules. Every declared input is borrowed, every rule reference is an exact module-qualified function call, and the result is bool.
numeric: UInt64 is u64. V2 canonical decimal literals must fit u64 and are emitted with an explicit u64 suffix. No signed or floating narrowing is allowed.
ownership: Inputs and nested paths are borrowed. Collection transformations allocate only a local owned result where the declared operator requires it. No clone changes the native concept type or entity identity.
effects: The generated function performs no I/O, environment access, mutation, provider call or panic-based business failure.
failure: Generation rejects unavailable Rule references, incomplete or same-typed wrong argument bindings, invalid property ownership, unsupported type/operator combinations, symbol collisions and stale checked inputs.
